ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 70% high-intensity white pixels and 30% low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels on the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white central field across both lobes. Thick, irregular black pigmentation along the trailing edges and the lower proximal region. Distinctive black mottling and focal spotting in the lower-left quadrant and near the notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression with a vertex approximately 45-55 degrees; depth is significant relative to total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations along the entire trailing edge, characterized by sharp, irregular peaks and deep jagged valleys, particularly prominent on the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Left lobe shows a broad convex sweep on the leading edge transitioning to an irregular, upward-sloping jagged trajectory on the trailing edge.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-relief, circular barnacle colonization visible on the extreme lateral tips and upper margins of both fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned linear scratches and rake marks (at least 6-8 distinct lines) crossing the white ventral field of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular trailing edge profile suggesting past tissue loss or predation; heavy biological encrustation on distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Yellowish-brown pigmentation/staining present in the center-right portion of the left lobe's white field.
